comment: Persistent record of (selector, property) pairs where the synthetic fixture's measured 'native' value is WRONG on the real /chat page, proven by test/expr-realab.js with an empty palette. gen-css.js gates every pair listed here (no fallback => the rule only fires once the user actually sets that variable). This file must never be shrunk automatically: the A/B harness measures the currently-deployed stylesheet, so once a pair is gated the harness passes and the evidence would otherwise disappear on the next build.
reason_light_shell: fixture measured 14px, real page renders 22px: the 14px rule is `body:not(.electron-chat-window)...` and the real /chat body carries .electron-chat-window, so it never applies there.
reason_light_input: fixture matched an @media (max-width:768px) branch and could not see the app's runtime-injected <style> layer (which wins with !important): real value is rgba(255,255,255,0.5) light / rgba(40,40,40,0.65) dark.
reason_dark_shell_border: the app's runtime <style> sets border-top-color: rgba(127,144,170,0.25) !important on .composer-input-shell, beating the stylesheet the fixture measured.
